title: Top 5 Champions for Climbing Solo Queue This Patch
content:

title: Mid Lane Wave Management Guide
content:
## Wave Management for Mid Lane

Learn how to control minion waves to gain advantages.

### Slow Push
- Last hit only
- Builds up a large wave
- Dive opponent under turret

### Fast Push
- Clear wave quickly
- Freeze near your turret
- Deny enemy CS

### Freeze
- Keep wave just outside turret
- Safe farming
- Easy gank setup

title: Patch 13.x Jungle Changes Analysis
content:
## Patch 13.x Jungle Changes

### Key Changes
1. Camp respawn increased by 15s
2. Jungle pet damage adjusted
3. New epic monster mechanics

### Impact
- Farming junglers buffed slightly
- Gank timing more important
- Objective control is key

### Recommended Junglers
- Udyr (farm heavy)
- Xin Zhao (early ganks)
- Lee Sin (balanced)
